title: Find the same job built twice across repos, looking back and looking ahead
why: Each repo builds its own copy of a job that one shared home could serve, so fixes and best practice drift apart. lint/find_copies.py finds only word-for-word copies, not the same job in other words. Owner 10:22 CST Nov 11: "it would be optimal if something identified shared savings opportunities like this in a sense across my repos retroactively and proactively".
note: Ruling R29 (owner answer 10:24 CST, "A"; relayed 10:24-10:25 CST; plan 574d1b5 under item 3.14 (moved from 3.6 by plan 7e04144, 10:52 CST), after R28). Parts: (1) looking back: at each compliance check a meaning match finds the same job built twice across repos, and each find goes to claude-settings triage as a candidate for one shared home (extends lint/find_copies.py); (2) looking ahead: the plan refuter asks "does this job already exist?" before a build; (3) both read one list of jobs and their homes. No new process. The cross-repo read needs a session on the owner's computer, or each repo attached. Starts after the R28 deeper audit.
source: owner 2026-11-11 10:22-10:24 CST, relayed by the retrospective session and the coordinator
